cover.title: 5 niche ways to get recommended by superintelligence

inner.title: let the bots in
inner.body: allow oai-searchbot, perplexitybot and claude-searchbot to crawl your site. your cdn firewall can block them even when robots.txt says yes.

inner.title: get named, not linked
inner.body: get your brand named beside your category on other sites. across 75,000 brands, mentions tracked chatgpt visibility far better than backlinks ever did.

inner.title: answer in 60 words
inner.body: put the buyer's question in the heading and answer it in 60 words. one-sided comparisons read as ads, and models tend to skip them.

inner.title: claim a tiny category
inner.body: pick a narrow category you can credibly win, before anyone else does. once a brand owns one in chatgpt, it keeps first place in 90.4% of monthly checks.

inner.title: ask the machines monthly
inner.body: ask chatgpt, claude, perplexity, gemini and copilot the same five buyer questions every month. default analytics often hides their visits under direct.

closer.HEADLINE:
si doesn't rank you.
it repeats you.
closer.SUBLINE: so make the internet say your name first.
closer.TONIGHT: check your cdn isn't blocking the search bots
closer.NEXT_WEEK: ship a page for your most-lost question
